name: Implicit Bias
excerpt: Implicit Bias involves subconscious influences on perception and behavior.
notes: Implicit Bias is one of the five distortions in perceptions that can affect organizational behavior and employee behavior. It involves subconscious expectations that can direct reality.
context_summary:
- Involves subconscious influences on perception
- Affects organizational behavior
- Affects employee behavior
- Directs reality through subconscious expectations
